title: Pipestone National Monument: Holiday Hours
summary: On Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day the visitor center will be closed (trails will remain open with access to restrooms on the north side of the building).

title: Pipestone National Monument: Possible Bridge Closure
summary: The Circle Trail bridge under Winnewissa Falls may be closed temporarily due to flooding caused by spring rain. Please pay attention to signage posted in the Visitor Center and at the bridge. The rest of the park and Circle Trail remain open.

title: Pipestone National Monument: Prescribed Burn on Monday, May 11
summary: The prescribed burn for May 11 has concluded and the Circle Trail is now open to visitors.
